text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary group prompt-mux-v2 (new routing endpoint /prompt/v2) error rate spiked to 18% (>5% threshold) in us-west-2. Rolling 5% traffic to canary.
oncall-jamal: paging @jamal (PD-1) — taking it now.
sara: seeing same in dashboard — client 502s and elevated 5xx, tail latency up to 3.2s.
lina: is traffic leaking to stable? split looks correct but retries are up.
oncall-jamal: initial hypothesis: new kernel selection path causes OOM/backpressure on a subset of hosts.
deploy-bot: deploy job canary-deploy/2026-03-17 started by @lina at commit abc123 (image: prompt-mux:v2)
oncall-jamal: i'm going to trigger emergency toggle to divert canary traffic back to stable. paging infra.
ops-bot: @infra notified. preparing toggle command.
ops-bot: command to run:
```
redwood feature-toggle set routing.prompt_mux_v2.enabled false --env=prod --scope=canary
```
oncall-jamal: executing now...
ops-bot: API response 200 OK — toggle submitted.
deploy-bot: Feature toggle change confirmed: routing.prompt_mux_v2.enabled=false for canary group (applied to 5% slice)
sara: error rate dropping — 2.1% after ~45s :thumbsup:
lina: kicking off canary audit (logs + kernel traces) and collecting KV cache dumps from affected hosts.
product-lead: quick customer check — any CS tickets yet? severity?
cust-support: two tickets opened complaining about slow/failed chat responses (CS-5421, CS-5422). We notified customers that the experiment was rolled back.
oncall-jamal: handing off to @lina for root-cause + postmortem. tagging @product-lead for customer comms.
lina: taking lead. timeline for notes: canary flip 14:02, spike detected 14:05, emergency toggle 14:08. Will attach kernel traces and OOM logs.
infra: queued host-level dumps and dmesg logs from affected nodes; will add to incident artifacts.
sara: FYI save KV cache state from canary hosts before any repro — might help root cause.
oncall-jamal: service stable, alert suppressed. follow-ups in #postmortems and assigned to @lina and @infra.
deploy-bot: Incident closed (toggle applied). Incident ID: INC-2026-0317-01.
product-lead: I'll draft a short customer-facing notification and sync with CS for next steps.
lina: will run repro in staging with the same kernel selection flags and share findings in the postmortem doc.
ops-bot: logging handoff: oncall -> lina, incident owner assigned.
note: This thread contains the root alert and subsequent coordination: emergency feature toggle, on-call handoff, customer impact notes, and follow-up assignment.
